granola-ai-alternatives.1: Usually because their needs grew. The free plan keeps only 30 days of history, while teams want shared notes, video, or tasks that land in Jira. Some people still believe Granola is Mac-only. Not anymore.
granola-ai-alternatives.2: Below are 7 alternatives, and when each one beats Granola.
granola-ai-alternatives.3: The top reason is the free plan. Granola Basic keeps only 30 days of meeting history and limits AI chat to its "Auto" model, while unlimited history starts at $14 per user per month on Business.
granola-ai-alternatives.5: Granola now runs on Mac, Windows, iPhone and Android. Android arrived on 1 July 2026 for in-person conversations, so older "Granola for Android" alternatives lists are out of date. Linux? No app.
granola-ai-alternatives.6: On Linux, your best route is a local open-source tool or a browser-based recorder, and Lynkk's web app and Chrome extension work from any desktop browser.
granola-ai-alternatives.9: Lynkk keeps what people like about Granola, bot-free capture through a Mac app or Chrome extension, and adds a bot for Zoom, Google Meet and Teams when you want hands-off recording. In-person conversations are recorded too.
granola-ai-alternatives.11: Free covers 5 notes a month at up to 2 hours each, Pro is $15 a month, and 17 languages are supported, Hindi and Hinglish included. **Trade-off:** no Windows or mobile apps yet.
granola-ai-alternatives.13: Jamie is the closest match to Granola's philosophy: no bot, notes for online and in-person meetings, and 99+ languages. Hosting is in the EU. Free gives 10 AI notes a month up to 30 minutes each; Team is $37 per seat billed yearly. See our [Jamie AI note taker review](https://lynkk.ai/blog/jamie-ai-note-taker).
granola-ai-alternatives.14: Notion's AI Meeting Notes capture meetings without a bot and save notes straight into your workspace. Included in Business at $20 per member per month. Free and Plus only get a limited trial. Details are in our [Notion AI note taker review](https://lynkk.ai/blog/notion-note-taker).
granola-ai-alternatives.15: Fathom records unlimited calls with video for free, which fills Granola's biggest gap, and Premium is $16 a month billed yearly. Compare them directly in [Granola vs Fathom](https://lynkk.ai/blog/granola-vs-fathom).
granola-ai-alternatives.17: Otter shows a live transcript during the call. On the free plan you get 300 minutes a month, with a 30-minute cap per conversation. See [Granola vs Otter AI](https://lynkk.ai/blog/granola-vs-otter-ai).
granola-ai-alternatives.18: Meetily runs on your own machine and keeps audio local, which suits developers and privacy-first teams willing to manage setup. Expect fewer integrations. No managed cloud search, either.
granola-ai-alternatives.22: The best free pick depends on your bottleneck. Hitting Granola's 30-day history limit? Fathom or Lynkk keep your notes longer. Want no bot at all? Jamie or Meetily match Granola's approach.
granola-ai-alternatives.24: Granola handles in-person meetings on iPhone and Android, and among the alternatives, Lynkk (Mac app and web), Jamie and Otter's mobile apps also record in-person conversations.
granola-ai-alternatives.28: Granola itself now runs on Windows for video calls. Want an alternative? Fathom, Fireflies and Otter work through a meeting bot on any operating system, and Lynkk works from any desktop browser. If you only want notes, Granola is still the simplest choice.
granola-ai-alternatives.23: The most private Granola alternatives are local tools like Meetily, where audio never leaves your machine. Among cloud tools, look for three things: bot-free capture, a data region you choose, and a no-training promise.
granola-ai-alternatives.16: Fireflies joins calls, transcribes them and pushes data into CRMs. Pro is $10 per seat billed yearly. Business? $19.
